claims.statement: 有限且正的 grad_norm 只说明至少有参数收到非零梯度，不能证明每个参数都有梯度。
claims.location: course/training.md#T.2，grad_norm 表列與後續限制段落
claims.scope: The returned default L2 norm is the total before clipping. It is computed over existing parameter gradients without a sample/parameter averaging denominator. It does not identify which individual component or all components received gradients.

evidence.supports: Default L2 total over present grads, grad=None excluded, pre-clipping total returned.

evidence.locator: sqrt(sum_i g_i^2); scalar L=(p-1)^2 at p=2
evidence.supports: Finite positive squared-sum norm implies some nonzero entries, not every parameter gradient.
Independent float64 norm matches returned values; vision has 8 parameter tensors without gradient despite positive total norm, and an unused scalar stays grad=None.

verification.expected: Returned norm agrees with independently calculated pre-clipping sqrt(sum of squared entries); positive norm can coexist with grad=None. Two-scalar calculation gives loss 1, gradient/norm 2, unused gradient None, p unchanged at 2.
verification.observed: Manual/returned norms: text 1.0268329500062614/1.026832938194275; sft 2.765059824862742/2.765058994293213; vision 1.8985441444777962/1.8985438346862793. Vision has 26 gradients among 34 parameter tensors and 8 without. The scalar variation exactly matches expected values.
verification.details: CPU gradients were inspected before original clip_grad_norm_ executes. The float64 calculation uses all available gradients and no count denominator; positive tests refer to total magnitude, not gradient sign or ability. Parameters remain unchanged by backward and clipping.
verification.tolerance: Norm comparison relative 2e-6 and absolute 2e-6; scalar loss/gradient/norm/parameter values and gradient-presence counts exact.

claims.statement: 有效位置统计若提供应大于零；此 vision 入口 effective_tokens 可为 null，代表未提供数量，不能读成零目标；个别零件及回答位置可回查 5.1/10.7。
claims.scope: Current default task reporting contract. Text/sft count post-padding labels unequal to -100. Vision takes equal-example mean of four per-example masked losses and publishes no count. Cross-reference inspection confirms relevance only; other sections' technical claims/figures are not endorsed here.

evidence.supports: Vision effective=None and per-example mean; text/sft effective=int((y!=-100).sum()).
Nonempty scored labels and loss denominator per valid target position.
Assistant targets counted after shift and padding; ignored labels excluded.
Original reports 111, 8 and null; direct label observation confirms all are nonempty, vision has four sets of seven targets.

verification.expected: text/sft published counts equal valid scoring positions >0; vision publishes JSON null but still has nonzero answer targets; links resolve to the stated relevant current sections.
verification.observed: text 111 and sft 8 equal observed label counts. Vision null, with 7 scored positions in each of 4 examples, total 28; all four per-example losses are nonempty. 5.1 includes embedding-gradient inspection; 10.7 includes answer-label alignment.
verification.details: Counted post-alignment labels at each original masked_loss call in bounded observation. The 28 total is an internal observed batch count, not a fabricated published field or an alternative token-weighted vision loss denominator. Original loss branch averages four example means.

Independent aggregate L2 interpretation
sources.details: For available finite gradient entries g_i, default total norm is sqrt(sum_i g_i^2), without a parameter-count or sample-count denominator. A finite total greater than zero implies at least one nonzero entry, while omitted grad=None parameters remain unproved. At p=2, L=(p-1)^2 gives dL/dp=2, L=1, with an unused parameter having grad=None; both parameter values stay unchanged after backward and clipping.

factual_accuracy.details: Six grouped claims cover all substantive concept, command, report-interface, numeric gradient and target-count statements; actual original computation and authoritative autograd/optimizer/norm semantics agree.

numeric_verification.details: Checked finite loss, strictly positive finite aggregate norm, actual scored-target counts and axes, no parameter-count denominator, independent pre-clipping L2 calculation, and a two-scalar counterexample to all-parameter inference. No textbook performance scores or embedded numeric worked example are present.

figure_consistency.details: T.2 references no figure or SVG and has no Python fence; its table supplies the diagnostic field mapping. No T.2 diagram render/view is applicable. Linked other-section figures are outside this target.

source_verification.details: Personally read original PyTorch source over HTTPS at exact installed git commit, preserving relevant source bytes and full response hashes; AST-located current repository computation and API contracts are frozen byte-identically. Candidate URLs or previous verdicts did not substitute for inspection.

limitations.details: This is one-batch flow/gradient diagnosis without updates, saved weights or capability evaluation. Aggregate norm does not establish every parameter's gradient. Vision null is a missing count, not no targets. No full training, GPU, downloads, data-cache or new capability-score validation was performed.
